# Koombea

> > Koombea is a software development company offering AI-powered services, custom application development, and managed IT solutions across mobile, web, and enterprise platforms.

Koombea specializes in end-to-end software development services including project-based development, staff augmentation, application maintenance, and innovative tools like ScopeGen AI for project scoping. The company serves businesses seeking digital transformation through custom mobile apps, web applications, enterprise solutions, and managed IT services.

## Key Topics

- Software Development
- Mobile App Development
- iOS & Android
- Web Development
- Cross-Platform Development
- Enterprise Applications
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- AI-Powered Tools
- Agile Methodology
- MVP Development
- Staff Augmentation
- Application Maintenance
- Shopify Development
- UX/UI Design
- Managed IT Services

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://www.koombea.com/services): Koombea services overview including mobile, web, and outsourcing solutions
- [Project-Based Development](https://www.koombea.com/services/project-based-development): Project-based development service with fixed costs and Agile methodology
- [IT Staff Augmentation Services](https://www.koombea.com/services/it-staff-augmentation): IT staff augmentation service for seamless team integration
- [Managed IT Services](https://www.koombea.com/services/managed-it-services): Managed IT services including cloud, cybersecurity, and MSP support
- [Application Maintenance and Support](https://www.koombea.com/services/application-maintenance-and-support): Application maintenance and ongoing support for software efficiency
- [App Development Rescue Projects](https://www.koombea.com/services/rescue-projects): App rescue projects to realign failing software initiatives

## Mobile App Development

- [Mobile App Development Services](https://www.koombea.com/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile app development for iOS, Android, and cross-platform solutions

- [Android App Development Services](https://www.koombea.com/services/android-app-development): Android app development for phones, tablets, and Wear OS devices
- [Cross-Platform App Development Services](https://www.koombea.com/services/cross-platform-app-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps with cost efficiency
- [Hybrid App Development Services](https://www.koombea.com/services/hybrid-app-development): Hybrid app development across iOS, Android, and Windows platforms
